items.text: Kenani pi, Mahalaleli pie, Yaredi pie;
Enoka pi, Metusela pie, Lameki pie;
Noa pi, Semi pie, Hamu pie, Yafeti pie.
Yafeti anzipi: Gomeri pi, Mago­gi pi, Madai pi, Yavani pi, Tubali pi, Meseki pi, Tirasi pie.
Gome­ri anzipi: Asikenazi pi, Difati pi, Togarima pie.
Yavani anzipi: Elisa pi, Tarisisi pi, Kitimu pi, ’ba Rodanini ’diyi pie.
Hamu anzipi: Kusi pi, Mizirai­mu pi, Puti pi, Kanani pie.
Kusi anzipi: Seba pi, Havila pi, Sabita pi, Raama pi, Sabiteka pie. Raama anzipi: Seba pi, Dedani be.
Ku­si ti Nimirodini; eri e’do ovuzu ’ba okporu nyaku driani,
Miziraimu ti ’ba Ludini piyi, ’ba Anamuni pie, ’ba Lehabini pie, ’ba Nafituhini pie,
’ba Patiru­sini pie, ’ba Kasiluhini pie (’ba Filisitini enga ’ba ’diyi ma alia), ’ba Kafitorini pie dria.
Kanani ti Zidoni mva erini okori pi, Heti pie,
’ba Yebusini pie, ’ba Amorini pie, ’ba Girigasini pie,
’ba Hivini pie, ’ba Arikini pie, ’ba Sinini pie,
’ba Arivadini pie, ’ba Zemarini pie, ’ba Hamarini pie dria.
Semi anzipi yi ’di: Elamu pi, Asuri pi, Aripakisadi pi, Ludi pi, Aramu pi, Uzi pi, Huli pi, Geteri pi, Meseki pie.
Aripakisadi ti Sela­ni; Sela ti Eberini.
Anzi tile Eberi dri ’diyi ndra iri: aluri ma ru Pelegi’i, ewu erinia nyakuni i awale rarisi; adripi eriniri ma ru Yokitani’i.
Yokitani ti Alimodadi pi, Selefi pie, Hazarimaveti pie, Yera pie,
Hadoramu pie, lizali pie, Dikila pie,
Ebali pie, Abimaeli pie, Seba pie,
Ofiri pie, Havila pie, Yobabu pie. ’Ba ’diyi dria Yokitani ma anzi.
Semi pi, Aripakisadi pie, Sela pie;
Eberi pi, Pelegi pie, Reu pie;
Serugi pi, Nahori pie, Tera pie;
Iburahimu anzipi: Isaka pi Isimaeli be.
’Diyi yi ma a’bi­anzi: mva Isimaelini tile okori Nebayoti’i; vutinia Kedari pi, Adi­beeli pie, Mibisamu pie,
Misi­ma pie, Duma pie, Masa pie, Hadadi pie, Tema pie,
Yeturi pie, Nafisi pie, Kedema pie. ’Ba ’diyi Isimaeli ma anzi.
Anzi Ketura Iburahimu vile oku azinirini tile ’diyi: Zimirani pi, Yokisani pie, Medani pie, Midiani pie, Isibaki pie, Sua pie. Yokisani anzipi: Seba pi Dedani be.
Midiani anzipi: Efa pi, Eferi pi, Hanoki pi, Abida pi, Elidaa pie. ’Ba ’diyi dria Ketura ma anzi.
Iburahimu ti Isakani. Isaka anzipi: Esau pi Israeli be.
Esau anzipi: Elifazi pi, Rueli pi, Yeusi pi, Yalamu pi, Kora pie.
Elifazi anzipi: Temani pi, Omari pi, Zefi pi, Gatamu pi, Kenazi pi, Timina pi, Amaleki pie.
Rueli anzipi: Na­hati pi, Zera pi, Sama pi, Miza pie.
Seiri anzipi: Lotani pi, Sobali pi, Zibeoni pi, Ana pi, Disoni pi, Ezeri pi, Disani pie.
Lotani anzipi: Hori pi Homamu be; isu Lotani ma amvini Timina’i.
So­bali anzipi: Aliani pi, Manahati pi, Ebali pi, Sefi pi, Onamu pie. Azini Zibeoni anzipi: Aya pi Ana be.
Ana anzipi: Disoni piyi. Disoni anzipi; Hamurani pi, Esibani pi, tirani pi, Kerani pie.
Ezeri anzipi: Bilani pi, Zaavani pi, Yaakani pie. Disani anzipi: Uzi pi Arani be.
Te opi angu Edomuni nyapi de nga opi azini nyani angu ’ba Israelini ma drilia ku ’diyi yi ’eli: Bela Beori mvi’i; eri ma aku ambori Dinihaba’i.
Bela ka dra ’bo, Yobabu Zera mvi ’ba Boziraari nya angu eri ma pariani.
Yobabu ka dra ’bo, Husamu engapi ’ba Temanini ’diyi vile anguari nya angu eri ma pariani.
Husamu ka dra ’bo, Hadaeli Bedari mvi, ’ba Midia­nini ofupi nyamuko Moabuariari, nya angu eri ma pariani: aku erini ambori ma ru Abiti’i.
Hadaeli ka dra ’bo, Samila ’ba Masirekaari nya angu eri ma pariani.
Samila ka dra ’bo, Saulo Rehoboti Yi ara ma tiariari nya angu eri ma pariani.
Saulo ka dra ’bo, Baali-hanani Akibori mvi nya angu eri ma pariani.
Baali-hanani ka dra ’bo, Hadadi nya angu eri ma pariani; aku erini ambori ma ru Pai’i, oku eri vileri ma ru Mahetabeli, Matredi Mezahabu zi ma zi’i.
Te Hadaeli dra ra. ’Ba amboru opianziru ovupi Edo­mija ’diyi yi ’eli: opi Timina pi, opi Alia pi, opi Yeteti pi,
opi Oholibama pi, opi Ela pi, opi Pinoni pi,
opi Kenazi pi, opi Temani pi, opi Mibizari pi,
opi Magidieli pi, opi Iramu pie. ’Diyi ’ba amboru opianziru Edomua ’diyi.
